scraped.scraped_description: Riseup provides online communication tools for people and groups working on liberatory social change. We are a project to create democratic alternatives and practice self-determination by controlling our own secure means of communications.

name: Riseup
tagline: Secure online communication tools for people and groups working on liberatory social change
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Reliance on volunteer labor and donations
Single point of failure for activist communications infrastructure
news_articles: Guardian coverage of encrypted email services
academic_citations: Citations in digital rights and cybersecurity literature
documented_limitations: Service disruptions documented (network switch outage May 2021, scheduled outages)
jurisdictional_scope: Global, but subject to varying national laws
failure_modes: Service availability dependent on volunteer capacity
curation_criteria: Community-driven, open to activists and social movements aligned with liberatory principles
controversies: Ongoing surveillance and legal pressure from various governments
legal_regulatory_issues: Subject to government surveillance requests and legal challenges in multiple jurisdictions; history of law enforcement action
political_relevance_summary: Riseup addresses digital rights and online freedoms. Secure online communication tools for people and groups working on liberatory social change.

movement_building_utility.notes: Amplifies advocacy efforts and helps citizens influence decision-makers.

generalizability_notes: Open-source codebase facilitates replication; already deployed across multiple jurisdictions.
